title: What's New: Using Enforced Digital Vouchers (2023 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Background on vouchers and digital vouchers
Digital vouchers in modern accounting and automation
Differences between attachments and digital vouchers
Demonstration of purchase and sales invoices

features.name: Enforced Digital Vouchers
features.description: A feature that makes digital vouchers mandatory for specific document types and journals in Business Central. Users cannot post documents without required attachments or digital documents based on configured rules. The system can automatically generate and attach digital vouchers based on transaction type.
caveats: In Denmark, users cannot disable enforcing mandatory vouchers in purchase and sales transactions from January next year
Feature applicability depends on company rules and local authority requirements

features.name: Automatic Digital Voucher Generation
features.description: The system can automatically create and attach digital vouchers when posting documents, such as sales invoices, without requiring manual user action. This option can be configured per entry type.
caveats: Can be skipped if manual attachments are already added based on user preference
Only available when generate automatically option is enabled

features.name: Digital Voucher Control Types
features.description: Configurable control options for enforcing digital vouchers: no check (not enforced), digital file only, attachments plus invoice (with electronic document), or attachment or note (file or text note). Setup can be configured per document or journal entry type.
caveats: Danish users have mandatory enforcement for purchase and sales transactions from January next year
Setup depends on company rules except where authorities require enforcement

features.name: Source Code Filtering for Digital Vouchers
features.description: Allows enforcing digital vouchers for specific documents with additional filtering by source code. For example, enforcing digital vouchers in general journal only when source code is payroll or similar, providing more granular control than entry type alone.
caveats: Only applicable to journals where various source codes are used

features.name: Guided Setup Wizard
features.description: A guided wizard to enable and configure the enforced digital vouchers feature. Users can select entry types such as sales documents, purchase documents, or various journal types and configure enforcement settings for each.

features.name: Digital Voucher to General Ledger Entry Connection
features.description: Digital vouchers are automatically connected to general ledger entries after posting, allowing the associated files to be viewed and accessed from the GL entry records themselves.
